name: N,N-dimethylhomotryptamine
summary: Dimethylhomotryptamine (DMHT; developmental code name U-6056), also known as N,N-dimethylhomotryptamine or as 3-[3-(dimethylamino)propyl]indole, is a homotryptamine and homologue of the psychedelic tryptamine dimethyltryptamine (DMT) in which the alkyl side chain has been lengthened by one carbon atom.
